$comment: The Pixel Forge stage table: canonical for the tracker page, the morning check and docs/status.md. A project's progress (0-100) sits inside its stage's min-max band. 'exit' is what must be true to leave the stage.

stages.name: Idea
stages.exit: Started: the project has its own folder (Start pressed on the page, or a folder found in the projects root).

stages.name: Concept
stages.exit: Pitch, hook, comparables and scope written in docs/concept.md.

stages.name: Design
stages.exit: docs/bible.md written, forge.json set up and the palette locked.

stages.name: Prototype
stages.exit: Grey-box core loop playable, and the playtest gate answered or a waiver recorded.

stages.name: Core build
stages.exit: Core loop works end to end and the art direction is locked.

stages.name: Art & content
stages.exit: Every needed asset at acceptable quality, and content lives in data.

stages.name: Polish & test
stages.exit: A full session with no placeholders, human playtests done, smoke test green.

stages.name: Launch prep
stages.exit: Release build signed, store page ready, trailer made.
